## What Will you Learn Today? {.incremental}

At the end of this workshop,

- You will <span style="color: tomato; font-weight: bold;">not</span> be able to program in Python

But, you will be able to say:

- I think I remember seeing something like that in the workshop.  I'll ask AI how to do it.  
- Or, I don't know if Python can do that.  But, I'll ask AI anyway.

##

And, you will be <span style="color: tomato; font-weight: bold;">comfortable with the process</span> of 

$$\text{Question} \; \mapsto \; \text{AI} \; \mapsto \; \text{Python} \; \mapsto \; \text{Output}.$$

## How Will We Get There?

- 14 self-guided and AI-guided notebooks
- Pause at designated points for everyone to catch up and then discuss

## Start Slow 


- After first 6 notebooks, you won't be able to do anything useful.
- But, you'll understand the <span style="color: tomato; font-weight: bold;">basic building blocks</span> of Python.

## Then Speed Up

- Fire hose of code.
- You will see what Python can do.
- Exercises become <span style="color: tomato; font-weight: bold;">ask Gemini to ...</span>
- No need to understand or remember every detail.  AI can do it!

## Get Started

- You need a Google account.
- You need to [install Google Drive](https://support.google.com/drive/answer/10838124?hl=en#d4d_install)  
- Drive should appear as a folder on your laptop.  In Windows Explorer, it is under `This PC`
- Create a new folder `This PC\Google Drive\My Drive\Workshop`

## Download and Extract the Zip File

- Download the zip file linked on [workshop.kerryback.com](https://workshop.kerryback.com) to `This PC\Google Drive\My Drive`
- Extract all the files to `This PC\Google Drive\My Drive\Workshop`

## Open Colab

- Go to [https://colab.research.google.com](https://colab.research.google.com)
- You should be looking at an Open Notebook screen
- Choose Google Drive
- Find and open `part1_colab.ipynb`

## Or use the Colab Links

- If for any reason you are unable to use Google Drive, open `Part1 Colab` at [workshop.kerryback.com](https://workshop.kerryback.com)
